name: authapp
description: Local development scripts for the Go + React auth app

scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run install:all
scripts.setup:env: test -f backend/.env || cp backend/.env.example backend/.env; test -f frontend/.env || cp frontend/.env.example frontend/.env
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.install:backend: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm --no-deps backend go mod download
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:wait
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.test: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c "go mod tidy && go test ./..."
scripts.swagger: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml run --rm --no-deps backend sh -c "go install github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@v1.16.3 && swag init -g cmd/server/main.go -o docs --parseDependency --parseInternal"
